content.text: What ashes of war are strictly worse versions of spells?

Once you count what each one costs a real melee build, three spells are strictly worse than an ash that does the same job, and a fourth is on a Faith build.

| Spell | Ash of war | Cost the spell adds |
|---|---|---|
| Golden Vow | Golden Vow | a seal and the Faith to cast it |
| Glintblade Phalanx | Glintblade Phalanx | a staff and the Intelligence to cast it |
